newsitem.title: FRANCE: Gas canister used again in Paris blast.
newsitem.headline: Gas canister used again in Paris blast.

text.p: The device which exploded in a Paris train station on Tuesday was stored in a 15-kg (33 lb) gas canister, similar to those used by Algerian Moslem fundamentalists in bombings last year, justice sources said.
The canisters used in last year's attacks were packed with nails to cause a maximum number of casualties when they exploded.

The highest casualty toll was in the first attack, on July 25, 1995, when eight people were killed and 84 injured by a gas canister which exploded on a packed commuter train on the same line as Tuesday's attack and only two stations away.
